  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness.",
  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is also the recommended first‑line treatment for melanoma in situ.",
  "The surgical margin for melanoma excision should be determined by the tumor thickness.",
  "Sentinel lymph node biopsy should be performed before wide excision of the primary melanoma when indicated.",
  "Sentinel lymph node biopsy should be performed in the same operative setting as wide excision whenever possible.",
  "When melanoma is suspected, the entire lesion should be completely excised with a narrow margin of 1–3 mm to allow histological diagnosis.",
  "Incisional biopsies can be performed on large lesions such as facial lesions (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral lesions, and genital lesions.",
  "The consensus rate for the primary excision recommendation is 100 % (21 out of 21 experts).",
  "The primary excision recommendation is based on consensus from a guideline consensus panel (GCP).",

  "The recommendation is supported by the American Academy of Dermatology guideline (PMID 30392755) table X for sentinel lymph node biopsy timing.",
